fee_notes: Cabin and Chalet royalty: 5% of Gross Sales; Kiosk: 6% (4% for airport/university/hospital non-traditional). Minimum royalty $6,000/year ($500/month equivalent). Marketing contribution up to 3% (currently 2% Brand Fund + 1% local). Technology fee estimated $400-$800/store/month.
